screens.name: Call page
screens.purpose: Understand one call in 10 seconds and go as deep as needed: hear it, read it in the caller's script, see why it ended, what it cost, why it was allowed, what she adapted and what she will remember.
screens.layout: 1280 px: header bar (64 px) with contact, outcome chip, reason line, total cost and actions; left column 60% with the two-lane stereo player on top and the synced transcript below; right column 40% with a tabbed inspector: Summary & outcome | Turns & speed | Why allowed | Cost | Run manifest | Memory. 390 px: stacked header chips, sticky mini-player, transcript, inspector tabs as accordions under it.

Outcome chip: 'Promised to pay by 28 Oct · AI guess (judge calibrating 31/50) · waiting for payment webhook'
Reason line: 'Completed · agenda 3 of 3 must items · she closed after goodbye'

Cost: 'Billed ₹7.28 (182 s at ₹2.40/min all-in) · illustrative' expanding to lines: Telephony (per second) ₹1.82 · Ears ₹0.55 · Brain ₹0.48 (62% cached) · Voice ₹1.10 · Analysis ₹0.17 · Platform ₹3.16
Actions: Play · Share 30-s clip · Add to test suite · Report a problem · Export · Ask about this call

Stereo player: lanes 'Asha (AI)' and 'Caller'; red overlap marks 'cut-in 01:12 (0.6 s)'; hang-up marker; clause ticks labelled by agenda moment ('value first', 'AI line', 'due date', 'ask'); speed 1x/1.25x/1.5x/2x; Skip silences

Transcript toggle Native | Romanised | English (on demand, est. ₹0.43); turn example native 'हाँ जी, पर इस महीने थोड़ा tight है' / romanised 'haan ji, par is mahine thoda tight hai' / English 'Yes, but this month is a bit tight'
Per turn: mm:ss, latency badge '1.3 s', mood chip 'worried', ledger chips 'told: due date ✓', play-from-here; unheard tail struck through with 'not heard: caller spoke over'
Adaptation marker: 'She slowed to 0.92x and offered the 28th: caller sounded worried (turn 6)'

Summary tab: 60-word summary; Agenda: Must confirm identity ✓, tell due date and premium ✓, send renewal link ✓; Never: discount talk ✓; Commitment '28 tak kar dungi' at 02:31; Objection 'is mahine thoda tight hai' at 01:55; Next action 'WhatsApp link sent 11:45 · confirmed'; Judges with pins: 'Outcome · v3 · pinned model · temp 0 · Calibrating 31/50 · Edit'

Memory tab: proposal 'Best time: after 6 pm' with quote 'शाम को छह बजे के बाद' at 01:42 [Approve] [Edit] [Reject]; 'Used this call: language Hindi ✓, slower pace ✓'

screens.name: Campaign overview
screens.purpose: The whole view of a campaign (req-21): where every person and every rupee went, from rows to earned outcomes, with drivers labelled honestly.
screens.layout: 1280 px: header (name, state, goal, outcome target, spend vs budget bar, freshness stamp); row 1 a horizontal 8-stage funnel with drop annotations; row 2 six KPI tiles each with n and freshness; row 3 a drivers panel with tabs Hour x day · Caller ID · Segment · Version · Voice; right rail with issues, approvals and an Ask box. 390 px: vertical funnel, tiles 2-up, drivers as cards.

screens.name: Mission control
screens.purpose: Watch live calls, step in safely and never miss a crisis, a loop or an opt-out.
screens.layout: Top strip: campaign state, live calls 18 of 20 lines (2 reserved for inbound), dials per minute, spend today vs budget, queue and window close time, health strip. Main: grid of live tiles (3 x 6 at 1280). Right: alert feed. Bottom drawer when a tile opens: rolling transcript and controls. 390 px: alert feed first, tiles as a list.

screens.name: Ask VP answer card
screens.purpose: Answer any question about calls and campaigns in Hinglish or English, with the same numbers as the pages, quotes that play, and honest labels.
screens.layout: Docked right panel (420 px) on every page, or full thread on the home route. Answer card: headline number, n, interval, label chip, 1-3 quote rows with play buttons, 'How this was computed' expander, action row.

Answer: 'Pune: 31% of dials reached a person vs 48% elsewhere (212 vs 972 dials, 14-20 Oct). Observed, not causal. 58% of Pune misses were switched-off messages, most between 13:00 and 15:00.'
Offer: 'Test 17:00-19:00 for Pune? About 217 dials per arm would show a 31% to 44% change.'
Quote rows for 'why do people hang up after the premium line?': '"itna kyun badh gaya" 01:48 ▶', '"abhi time nahi hai" 00:52 ▶'

screens.beats: Retell Conductor chips, Bolna's Ask Bolna and Sarvam's AI-drafted SQL boards answer questions, but none ties answers to verified quotes with play-from-here or guarantees the chat number equals the page number.

phases.phase: v1: understand every call and campaign (design-partner launch)
scope: Call page: stereo player, native and romanised transcript (on-demand English), turn timeline with latency segments and heard text, run manifest, compliance trace, INR cost lines, reason and action, visible judges
Reason catalogue v1 (34 codes) with carrier mapping for the primary carrier, refined after T4
Outcome definitions with webhook or CRM verification; calibration panel with quick-rate; 'AI guess' labels
Failed-call finder with reason groups and full-retention search
Campaign overview: 8-stage funnel with reasons, cost per outcome and per contact, drivers with observed and under-powered labels, best and worst calls, objection clusters with verified quotes
Drop-off by agenda moment with intervals and the catastrophic fast lane
Mission control: live tiles, concurrency, listen, text whisper, take over, end politely; crisis, loop, opt-out and AI-question alerts; anger alerts marked beta
Issues and 20 default monitors with honest health strip
Ask VP over the metric layer with play-from-here
Daily brief in-app and email; T6 export; signed webhooks with replay; CRM write-back for the first partners' CRMs

Evidence: 3 of the 21 must-be items (call log, export, post-call judge; WT l.428); W6 hypothesis and kill bar (TS l.328); req-21/22/25/26 are must; lab assets for the Plivo line, agenda ledger, cost meter and combination identity exist
Exit: T5 and T6 pass; 3 partners with outcomes wired; at least one judge Trusted per partner

phases.phase: v2: she remembers and gets better, visibly
scope: Per-tenant expected hazard curves and automatic drop-off flags feeding Coach proposals
Memory proposals live on the call page; contact timeline across voice, WhatsApp, SMS and email
'How she changed for you' timeline with intervals
Custom boards and read-only SQL for developers on the same metric layer; scheduled weekly and monthly reports; compliance digest
WhatsApp daily brief and alerts with consent; Hinglish voice whisper; spoken brief (idea, I)
Judge drift monitors; mood and anger alerts out of beta after precision is measured on synthetic callers
More CRMs
Evidence: 2x lines found 67% at 500 calls and 94% at 1,000 [C L6 L07]; memory and learning are v2 in the spine; owner order req-32 before req-34
Consented segment benchmarks (10+ opted-in tenants, about 3,000+ calls a day, aggregates only, contract clause)
Outcome forecasting with intervals per campaign
Self-hosted analysis model for BFSI residency
Command-centre layers (req-18)
Evidence: raw pooling gave the wrong winner to 48-55% of dissimilar tenants [C] (rejected.2026-10-17.cross-tenant-pooling); self-hosting pays only at volume (ECO s.4)

beyond: Business-language Indian failure reasons with carrier code and one action per attempt, including DND block, caller-ID or DLT rejection, operator announcements and windows (34-code catalogue)

Drop-off ribbon aligned to the TTS clause and agenda moment at hang-up, with credible intervals, a P > 0.99 flag and a catastrophic fast lane; the AI line shown as locked (wording can change, presence cannot)
Judge calibration against the client's own CRM or payment truth, with interval and the calls-needed penalty of an untrusted label; 'AI guess' until Trusted
Heard-vs-planned transcript showing exactly what the caller heard after a barge-in, with overlaps on the stereo waveform
Per-call 'why this call was allowed' compliance trace (category, local-time window, suppression check time, consent basis, attempt n of N, caller-ID series, disclosure time, reply-door interventions)
Per-call run manifest: exact combination, regions, brief hash, ledger version, turn preset in ms, fallbacks
Ask VP answers from the same metric layer as the pages, with verified quotes and play-from-here, and an offer to test with the sample size it needs
Honest health: never 'all good' unless monitors are on and read back
Cost per earned outcome against the client's own desk cost, and cost per contact across attempts
TRAI reg 21A guard: early-hang-up ratio per 10-digit caller ID with auto-pause and undo
Mood path and adaptation markers that show her emotional intelligence at work ('slowed down because the caller sounded worried')
'How she changed for you' timeline with measured deltas and intervals
Crisis protocol as predicate plus human alert, with Tele-MANAS 14416 and 112, and take-over that is human only
Phone-first daily brief with verified vs guessed outcomes and a 30-second clip worth hearing
Romanised transcript by deterministic transliteration (free, instant) and English only on demand, keeping analysis inside the all-in price
risks: LLM labels wrong on Hinglish (e.g. 'dekhta hoon' read as yes) erode trust; mitigated by verified sources, calibration with intervals and 'AI guess' labels, but buyers may still read guesses as facts

Clause alignment error: the phone-leg delay (250-450 ms, inferred) can attribute a hang-up to the wrong clause near boundaries; mitigated by a window and turn-level fallback until a handset battery measures it
Indian carriers' codes for DND blocks, CLI/DLT rejection and announcements are unknown until task T4 and live calls; early weeks may show a high UNKNOWN share
Alert fatigue from Hinglish mood or anger detection with low precision; v1 keeps anger in beta and alerts by predicate (crisis, opt-out, AI question) and code (loops)
PII exposure through live listening, exports and recording links; mitigated by role masking, Aadhaar/PAN redaction, signed expiring links and audit rows; lawful-basis questions remain for counsel
Whisper as a prompt-injection path into a live call; it enters as a delimited data block and passes the reply door, but adversarial testing is needed
Clients reading drivers as causes and acting on noise; labels help but do not remove the risk
Analysis cost creeping with many custom judges or default translation; translation is on demand and judges show their cost
Transcriber fabrication on silence corrupting the transcript of record and every downstream label (HV law 27); needs the non-speech probe per ASR choice
Judge model deprecation or silent provider reroute changing labels; pinned versions and drift monitors return labels to Calibrating
Competitors close part of the gap: Vapi's flag-gated Mission Control and Call Health (VAP-06), ElevenLabs' hidden campaigns product, Retell's hidden Campaigns enum
Overload for an SMB owner; mitigated by Today and progressive depth, still to be tested in 5-user sessions
